name: Mythology of the Titans
summary: Librarian Mae Paledust in Ironforge seeks a book said to have been kept in the old Monastery of Tirisfal. Its study may help reveal what the past can teach about the unknown ahead.

sections.title: A Lost Volume
sections.body: Before troubles came to Lordaeron, the old Monastery in Tirisfal Glades held a library of knowledge. Mae asks you to retrieve a book called Mythology of the Titans from there and bring it to her in Ironforge. She hopes that studying it will help uncover secrets of the past.

faq.q: Who is asking for the book?
faq.answer: Librarian Mae Paledust in Ironforge asks you to bring her Mythology of the Titans.

faq.q: Where is Mythology of the Titans said to be?
faq.answer: The book is rumored to be in the library of the old Monastery in Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: What is Mythology of the Titans?
faq.answer: It is a book said to have been housed in the old Monastery's library in Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: Why does Mae want the book?
faq.answer: Mae hopes studying the book may help reveal secrets of the past and prepare for the unknown.
